description.value: An alte roite adds his Wisdom bonus to his AC and CMD.

An alte roite may return to his form as a jura aevis as a swift action, or automatically as an immediate action when reduced to 0 or fewer hit points. Damage taken by the alte roite form carries over to the jura aevis, but negative status effects are removed.

effect: Change to Jura Aevis; damage carries over, conditions clear. Immediate at 0 HP.

description.value: An alte roite adds his Wisdom bonus to attack and damage with quarterstaffs.

An alte roite can cast a creature outside of time and space, temporarily negating its existence. If it fails a Will save (DC 28), it is inflicted with the Banished status effect for 6 rounds; it and all items it is carrying disappear into nothingness, ceasing to exist. At the end of this effect's duration, that creature reappears where it was. If another creature or object is occupying the space it reappears in, then the target is shunted off to the nearest open space and takes 1d6 points of damage per 5 ft. it traveled. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).
